answer: The atlas schedule is applied in mirror and inlet shows each instalment. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and thus 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1850 identities would post 1592 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
